description_en: You can call SetDcdnDomainSSLCertificate to enable or disable the certificate feature for a domain name and update the certificate information
description_zh: 调用SetDcdnDomainSSLCertificate设置某域名下是否启用证书功能及更新证书信息
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn set-dcdn-domain-ssl-certificate --domain-name example.com --ssl-protocol off --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDcdnDomainSSLCertificate

parameters.help_en: The domain name to which the certificate belongs. The domain name must be an HTTPS-accelerated domain name
parameters.help_zh: 证书所属的服务域名，需属于HTTPS加速类型
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the certificate. You can specify only one name. This parameter is valid only when CertType is set to upload. In this case, you can specify a name for the new certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书名称，目前只支持单个证书名称，只有CertType=upload时生效。
CertType=upload时选填，给新证书的名称
parameters.name: cert_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the certificate. This parameter is required only when CertType is set to cas. In this case, specify the ID of an existing certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书ID，只有CertType=cas时生效。
CertType=cas时必填，表示选择已有证书
parameters.name: cert_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the certificate. Valid values:

upload: A custom certificate that you upload.

cas: A certificate that you purchase from Alibaba Cloud SSL Certificates Service
parameters.help_zh:
证书类型。

upload：上传证书。
cas：证书中心证书
parameters.name: cert_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the SSL certificate. Valid values:

on: Enable.

off: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
HTTPS证书是否启用。

on：启用。
off：不启用
parameters.name: ssl_protocol

parameters.help_en: The content of the SSL certificate. Specify this parameter only when you enable the certificate
parameters.help_zh: 安全证书内容，不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入证书内容
parameters.name: ssl_pub

parameters.help_en: The content of the private key. Specify this parameter only when you enable the certificate
parameters.help_zh: 私钥内容，不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入私钥内容
parameters.name: ssl_pri

parameters.help_en: The region where the certificate is located. This parameter is valid only when you set CertType to cas. Valid values are cn-hangzhou and ap-southeast-1. The default value is cn-hangzhou. If you are an Alibaba Cloud international account user, set this parameter to ap-southeast-1
parameters.help_zh: 证书所在地域。支持cn-hangzhou和ap-southeast-1，默认cn-hangzhou。国际站用户建议使用ap-southeast-1
parameters.name: cert_region
